_setup_display_seconds: How long to show the setup (recommended: 4-5)
_punchline_display_seconds: How long to show the punchline (recommended: 5-7)
_transition_pause: Pause duration showing '...' between setup and punchline (recommended: 1-2)
_max_joke_length: Maximum characters for jokes (filters long jokes). 64x32=80, 128x64=120
_show_ellipsis: Show '...' transition between setup and punchline (true/false)
